column10: based on Fallout's Cannon Materials Sheet
All wings were crafted with the same quality material to keep the results consistent.
The best performing material of each attribute in each slot was then identified and all other materials in that attribute put into relation with it.
Example: Aluminium performed best for pivot speed in the Aileron with a resulting wing with 63 pivot speed, in comparison iron created a wing with 49 pivot speed.
Substracting the base pivot speed of the engine (40) that leaves aluminium with 23 added pivot speed and iron with with 9.
Aluminium's 23 added pivot speed being 100% makes iron's added pivot speed in relation 39.1% (rounded).
Base stats are substracted to increase the scalability of the results with wings other than the one used in testing.
